title: Make many jigsaws
intro: Choose how big and how hard, then pick pictures from your computer. Each picture becomes a jigsaw, and the AI sets its categories, name and description.
languageHelp: The language the names and the descriptions are written in.
ai: Let the AI set the categories, name and description
aiHelp: The pictures are sent to OpenAI to be looked at. Turn it off to keep the file names as the names.
